"""DS18B20 1-Wire temperature sensor.

Ds18b20Slave decodes the bus from level edges stamped in virtual ns:
master-driven slots are classified by their LOW duration (reset >= 400 us;
otherwise the slot's bit is the line level at the datasheet's typical 30 us
sample point, so a LOW shorter than 30 us is a 1); slave-driven replies
(presence pulse, read-slot 0-bits) are requested through `drive(low, at_ns)`
and the host lands them on its clock. The host (local/registry.py's `line`)
owns the wired-AND of the firmware's pin and this slave's level and feeds the
result to `on_line`.

Datasheet behaviors modeled (Maxim DS18B20, "ROM commands" / "function
commands"):
  ROM:      0xF0 Search (one device, so no discrepancy bits), 0x55 Match (a
            mismatched bit deselects the part until the next reset), 0xCC
            Skip, 0x33 Read ROM (selects the part, so a function command may
            follow), 0xEC Alarm Search (the part joins only while its alarm
            flag is set).
  Function: 0x44 Convert T samples the supplied temperature when issued;
            when the conversion ends it lands in the scratchpad at the
            configured resolution and refreshes the alarm flag (integer part
            >= TH or <= TL). 0xBE Read Scratchpad (9 bytes, CRC-8 last;
            mid-conversion it still holds the previous reading), 0x4E Write
            Scratchpad (TH, TL, config -- only R1/R0 in the config byte are
            writable, the rest read as 1), 0x48 Copy Scratchpad -> EEPROM,
            0xB8 Recall E2 -> scratchpad (instant), 0xB4 Read Power Supply
            (read slot idles HIGH = externally powered).
  Busy:     after Convert T, Copy Scratchpad or Recall E2, read slots answer
            0 while the operation runs and 1 once done. A conversion takes
            600 ms at 12 bits, halving per bit below (typical silicon; the
            datasheet only gives the 750 ms maximum); an EEPROM copy takes the
            typical 2 ms. A Convert T or Copy Scratchpad issued while either
            is running is ignored.
  Power-on: EEPROM TH 0x4B / TL 0x46 / config 0x7F (12-bit), temperature
            register 0x0550 (+85 C) until the first conversion.
  Resolution: 9-12 bits; the undefined low bits of the temperature register
            read 0.

A ROM or function command outside that list raises ValueError.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import Callable, List


def crc8(data, length: int) -> int:
    """Dallas/Maxim CRC-8 (poly 0x8C, LSB first)."""
    crc = 0
    for i in range(length):
        b = data[i]
        for _ in range(8):
            mix = (crc ^ b) & 1
            crc >>= 1
            if mix:
                crc ^= 0x8C
            b >>= 1
    return crc


CMD_SEARCH_ROM = 0xF0
CMD_READ_ROM = 0x33
CMD_MATCH_ROM = 0x55
CMD_SKIP_ROM = 0xCC
CMD_ALARM_SEARCH = 0xEC
CMD_CONVERT_T = 0x44
CMD_WRITE_SCRATCHPAD = 0x4E
CMD_READ_SCRATCHPAD = 0xBE
CMD_COPY_SCRATCHPAD = 0x48
CMD_RECALL_E2 = 0xB8
CMD_READ_POWER_SUPPLY = 0xB4

SP_TEMP_LSB = 0
SP_TEMP_MSB = 1
SP_TH = 2
SP_TL = 3
SP_CONFIG = 4
SP_CRC = 8

POWER_ON_TEMP_RAW = 0x0550  # +85 C
EEPROM_DEFAULTS = (0x4B, 0x46, 0x7F)

RESET_MIN_NS = 400_000
WRITE_SAMPLE_NS = 30_000
PRESENCE_SLACK_NS = 15_000
PRESENCE_START_NS = 30_000
PRESENCE_LEN_NS = 100_000
READ0_HOLD_NS = 30_000
CONVERSION_12BIT_NS = 600_000_000
EEPROM_COPY_NS = 2_000_000


def _signed8(b: int) -> int:
    return b - 256 if b & 0x80 else b


class Ds18b20Slave:
    """DS18B20 (family 0x28), VDD-powered. States: IDLE also covers
    "deselected" -- read slots go undriven, so the master reads 1. BUSY_POLL
    follows Convert T / Copy Scratchpad / Recall E2: read slots report whether
    the operation is still running."""

    def __init__(self, get_temperature: Callable[[], float],
                 drive: Callable[[bool, int], None],
                 write_sample_ns: int = WRITE_SAMPLE_NS,
                 read0_hold_ns: int = READ0_HOLD_NS) -> None:
        self._get_temperature = get_temperature
        self._drive = drive
        # The datasheet allows both anywhere in 15-60 us; a slow emulated host needs later points.
        self._write_sample_ns = write_sample_ns
        self._read0_hold_ns = read0_hold_ns
        self.rom = [0x28, 0x84, 0x9C, 0xA2, 0x17, 0x05, 0x00, 0]
        self.rom[7] = crc8(self.rom, 7)
        self.scratchpad = bytearray(9)
        self.eeprom = bytearray(EEPROM_DEFAULTS)
        self.alarm_flag = False

        self._state = 'IDLE'
        self._after_send = 'IDLE'
        self._rx_byte = 0
        self._rx_bits = 0
        self._tx_buf: List[int] = []
        self._tx_bit = 0
        self._search_idx = 0    # bit 0..63
        self._search_phase = 0  # 0 = bit, 1 = complement, 2 = master's direction bit
        self._dir_fall_seen = False
        self._match_idx = 0
        self._match_ok = True
        self._sp_idx = 0

        self._last_fall = 0
        self._line_low = False
        self._gate_until = 0  # our own presence pulse: ignore the edges we cause
        self._now = 0
        self._busy_until = 0
        self._pending_raw = None  # conversion result not yet in the scratchpad

        self.scratchpad[SP_TEMP_LSB] = POWER_ON_TEMP_RAW & 0xFF
        self.scratchpad[SP_TEMP_MSB] = POWER_ON_TEMP_RAW >> 8
        self.scratchpad[SP_TH:SP_CONFIG + 1] = self.eeprom
        self.scratchpad[5] = 0xFF
        self.scratchpad[6] = 0x0C
        self.scratchpad[7] = 0x10
        self.scratchpad[SP_CRC] = crc8(self.scratchpad, 8)

    # ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def on_line(self, high: bool, now_ns: int) -> None:
        """Every transition of the bus level, stamped in virtual ns."""
        self._now = now_ns
        if self._pending_raw is not None and now_ns >= self._busy_until:
            self._finish_conversion(self._pending_raw)
        if now_ns < self._gate_until:
            return
        if not high:
            if self._line_low:
                return
            self._line_low = True
            self._last_fall = now_ns
            self._on_fall(now_ns)
        elif self._line_low:
            self._line_low = False
            self._on_rise(now_ns, now_ns - self._last_fall)

    @property
    def resolution_bits(self) -> int:
        return 9 + ((self.scratchpad[SP_CONFIG] >> 5) & 3)

    @property
    def temperature_raw(self) -> int:
        return (self.scratchpad[SP_TEMP_MSB] << 8) | self.scratchpad[SP_TEMP_LSB]

    # ── internals ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _rom_bit(self, i: int) -> int:
        return (self.rom[i >> 3] >> (i & 7)) & 1

    def _answer_read0(self, now_ns: int) -> None:
        self._drive(True, now_ns)
        self._drive(False, now_ns + self._read0_hold_ns)

    def _start_conversion(self) -> None:
        undefined_bits = 12 - self.resolution_bits
        # math.floor(x + 0.5) is JS Math.round; Python's round() is half-to-even.
        self._pending_raw = (math.floor(self._get_temperature() * 16 + 0.5) & 0xFFFF) & ((0xFFFF << undefined_bits) & 0xFFFF)
        self._busy_until = self._now + (CONVERSION_12BIT_NS >> undefined_bits)

    def _finish_conversion(self, raw: int) -> None:
        self._pending_raw = None
        self.scratchpad[SP_TEMP_LSB] = raw & 0xFF
        self.scratchpad[SP_TEMP_MSB] = raw >> 8
        self.scratchpad[SP_CRC] = crc8(self.scratchpad, 8)
        # TH/TL compare against the integer part only (register bits 11..4), as signed bytes.
        whole_degrees = (raw - 0x10000 if raw & 0x8000 else raw) >> 4
        th = _signed8(self.scratchpad[SP_TH])
        tl = _signed8(self.scratchpad[SP_TL])
        self.alarm_flag = whole_degrees >= th or whole_degrees <= tl

    def _begin_send(self, data, then: str) -> None:
        self._state = 'SEND'
        self._after_send = then
        self._tx_buf = list(data)
        self._tx_bit = 0

    def _begin_search(self) -> None:
        self._state = 'SEARCH'
        self._search_idx = 0
        self._search_phase = 0
        self._dir_fall_seen = False

    def _on_rom_command(self, byte: int) -> None:
        if byte == CMD_SKIP_ROM:
            self._state = 'FUNC_CMD'
        elif byte == CMD_READ_ROM:
            self._begin_send(self.rom, 'FUNC_CMD')
        elif byte == CMD_SEARCH_ROM:
            self._begin_search()
        elif byte == CMD_ALARM_SEARCH:
            if self.alarm_flag:
                self._begin_search()
            else:
                self._state = 'IDLE'
        elif byte == CMD_MATCH_ROM:
            self._state = 'MATCH'
            self._match_idx = 0
            self._match_ok = True
        else:
            raise ValueError(f'ds18b20: unsupported ROM command 0x{byte:x}')

    def _on_function_command(self, byte: int) -> None:
        busy = self._now < self._busy_until
        if byte == CMD_CONVERT_T:
            if not busy:
                self._start_conversion()
            self._state = 'BUSY_POLL'
        elif byte == CMD_READ_SCRATCHPAD:
            self._begin_send(self.scratchpad, 'IDLE')
        elif byte == CMD_WRITE_SCRATCHPAD:
            self._state = 'WRITE_SP'
            self._sp_idx = 0
        elif byte == CMD_COPY_SCRATCHPAD:
            if not busy:
                self.eeprom[:] = self.scratchpad[SP_TH:SP_CONFIG + 1]
                self._busy_until = self._now + EEPROM_COPY_NS
            self._state = 'BUSY_POLL'
        elif byte == CMD_RECALL_E2:
            self.scratchpad[SP_TH:SP_CONFIG + 1] = self.eeprom
            self.scratchpad[SP_CRC] = crc8(self.scratchpad, 8)
            self._state = 'BUSY_POLL'
        elif byte == CMD_READ_POWER_SUPPLY:
            self._state = 'IDLE'
        else:
            raise ValueError(f'ds18b20: unsupported function command 0x{byte:x}')

    def _on_scratchpad_byte(self, byte: int) -> None:
        if self._sp_idx == 2:
            byte = (byte & 0x60) | 0x1F
        self.scratchpad[SP_TH + self._sp_idx] = byte
        self._sp_idx += 1
        if self._sp_idx == 3:
            self.scratchpad[SP_CRC] = crc8(self.scratchpad, 8)
            self._state = 'IDLE'

    def _on_write_bit(self, bit: int) -> None:
        if self._state == 'MATCH':
            if bit != self._rom_bit(self._match_idx):
                self._match_ok = False
            self._match_idx += 1
            if self._match_idx == 64:
                self._state = 'FUNC_CMD' if self._match_ok else 'IDLE'
            return
        self._rx_byte |= bit << self._rx_bits
        self._rx_bits += 1
        if self._rx_bits < 8:
            return
        byte = self._rx_byte
        self._rx_byte = 0
        self._rx_bits = 0
        if self._state == 'ROM_CMD':
            self._on_rom_command(byte)
        elif self._state == 'FUNC_CMD':
            self._on_function_command(byte)
        elif self._state == 'WRITE_SP':
            self._on_scratchpad_byte(byte)

    def _on_fall(self, now_ns: int) -> None:
        if self._state == 'SEND':
            if ((self._tx_buf[self._tx_bit >> 3] >> (self._tx_bit & 7)) & 1) == 0:
                self._answer_read0(now_ns)
            self._tx_bit += 1
        elif self._state == 'SEARCH':
            if self._search_phase == 0:
                if self._rom_bit(self._search_idx) == 0:
                    self._answer_read0(now_ns)
                self._search_phase = 1
            elif self._search_phase == 1:
                if self._rom_bit(self._search_idx) == 1:
                    self._answer_read0(now_ns)
                self._search_phase = 2
                self._dir_fall_seen = False
            elif self._search_phase == 2:
                self._dir_fall_seen = True
        elif self._state == 'BUSY_POLL':
            if now_ns < self._busy_until:
                self._answer_read0(now_ns)
        # Write-slot states decode on the rising edge (duration-based).

    def _on_rise(self, now_ns: int, low_dur_ns: int) -> None:
        if low_dur_ns >= RESET_MIN_NS:
            self._drive(True, now_ns + PRESENCE_START_NS)
            self._drive(False, now_ns + PRESENCE_START_NS + PRESENCE_LEN_NS)
            self._gate_until = now_ns + PRESENCE_START_NS + PRESENCE_LEN_NS + PRESENCE_SLACK_NS
            self._state = 'ROM_CMD'
            self._rx_byte = 0
            self._rx_bits = 0
            return
        bit = 1 if low_dur_ns < self._write_sample_ns else 0
        s = self._state
        if s in ('ROM_CMD', 'FUNC_CMD', 'MATCH', 'WRITE_SP'):
            self._on_write_bit(bit)
        elif s == 'SEND':
            # The slot's rise (the master's or our own release) closes the bit.
            if self._tx_bit == len(self._tx_buf) * 8:
                self._state = self._after_send
        elif s == 'SEARCH' and self._search_phase == 2 and self._dir_fall_seen:
            self._dir_fall_seen = False
            if bit != self._rom_bit(self._search_idx):
                self._state = 'IDLE'  # master steered toward another device
                return
            self._search_idx += 1
            self._search_phase = 0
            if self._search_idx == 64:
                self._state = 'IDLE'  # next transaction starts with a reset
        # IDLE rising edges are read-slot inits polling an undriven bus -- nothing to decode.

"""Unit tests for local/ds18b20.py (Ds18b20Slave).

Mirrors the browser part's tests (frontend/src/__tests__/ds18b20-protocol.test.ts):
the same wired-AND bus and the same OneWire (Paul Stoffregen) master timings,
bit for bit, with the clock in ns. Confirms the Python port decodes and
answers exactly like the AVR model.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from local.ds18b20 import Ds18b20Slave, crc8


def us(n: float) -> int:
    return round(n * 1000)


class Bus:
    """Wired-AND bus on a ns clock: the master and the slave each pull LOW or release."""

    def __init__(self, get_temperature):
        self.t = 0
        self.master_low = False
        self.slave_low = False
        self.line = True
        self.pending = []
        self.dev = Ds18b20Slave(get_temperature, self._schedule)

    def pull(self):
        self.master_low = True
        self._settle()

    def release(self):
        self.master_low = False
        self._settle()

    def sample(self) -> bool:
        return self.line

    def advance(self, microseconds: float):
        target = self.t + us(microseconds)
        while self.pending and self.pending[0][0] <= target:
            at, low = self.pending.pop(0)
            self.t = at
            self.slave_low = low
            self._settle()
        self.t = target

    def _schedule(self, low: bool, at: int):
        if at <= self.t:
            self.slave_low = low
            self._settle()
            return
        self.pending.append((at, low))
        self.pending.sort(key=lambda e: e[0])

    def _settle(self):
        high = not self.master_low and not self.slave_low
        if high == self.line:
            return
        self.line = high
        self.dev.on_line(high, self.t)


class Master:
    def __init__(self, bus: Bus):
        self.bus = bus
        self.reset_search()

    def reset(self) -> bool:
        self.bus.pull()
        self.bus.advance(480)
        self.bus.release()
        self.bus.advance(70)
        presence = not self.bus.sample()
        self.bus.advance(410)
        return presence

    def write_bit(self, bit: int):
        self.bus.pull()
        if bit:
            self.bus.advance(10)
            self.bus.release()
            self.bus.advance(55)
        else:
            self.bus.advance(65)
            self.bus.release()
            self.bus.advance(5)

    def read_bit(self) -> int:
        self.bus.pull()
        self.bus.advance(3)
        self.bus.release()
        self.bus.advance(10)
        r = 1 if self.bus.sample() else 0
        self.bus.advance(53)
        return r

    def write(self, v: int):
        for i in range(8):
            self.write_bit((v >> i) & 1)

    def read(self) -> int:
        r = 0
        for i in range(8):
            if self.read_bit():
                r |= 1 << i
        return r

    def read_bytes(self, n: int):
        return [self.read() for _ in range(n)]

    def select(self, rom):
        self.write(0x55)
        for b in rom:
            self.write(b)

    def skip(self):
        self.write(0xCC)

    def reset_search(self):
        self.last_discrepancy = 0
        self.last_device_flag = False
        self.rom_no = [0] * 8

    def search(self, alarm_only=False):
        """Port of OneWire::search -- the discrepancy walk."""
        id_bit_number = 1
        last_zero = 0
        rom_byte_number = 0
        rom_byte_mask = 1
        search_result = False
        if not self.last_device_flag:
            if not self.reset():
                self.reset_search()
                return None
            self.write(0xEC if alarm_only else 0xF0)
            while True:
                id_bit = self.read_bit()
                cmp_id_bit = self.read_bit()
                if id_bit == 1 and cmp_id_bit == 1:
                    break
                if id_bit != cmp_id_bit:
                    direction = id_bit
                else:
                    if id_bit_number < self.last_discrepancy:
                        direction = 1 if self.rom_no[rom_byte_number] & rom_byte_mask else 0
                    else:
                        direction = 1 if id_bit_number == self.last_discrepancy else 0
                    if direction == 0:
                        last_zero = id_bit_number
                if direction:
                    self.rom_no[rom_byte_number] |= rom_byte_mask
                else:
                    self.rom_no[rom_byte_number] &= ~rom_byte_mask
                self.write_bit(direction)
                id_bit_number += 1
                rom_byte_mask <<= 1
                if rom_byte_mask == 0x100:
                    rom_byte_number += 1
                    rom_byte_mask = 1
                if rom_byte_number >= 8:
                    break
            if id_bit_number >= 65:
                self.last_discrepancy = last_zero
                if self.last_discrepancy == 0:
                    self.last_device_flag = True
                search_result = True
        if not search_result or not self.rom_no[0]:
            self.reset_search()
            return None
        return list(self.rom_no)


class Rig:
    def __init__(self, temperature=25.0):
        self.temp = temperature
        self.bus = Bus(lambda: self.temp)
        self.master = Master(self.bus)
        self.dev = self.bus.dev

    def read_scratchpad(self):
        assert self.master.reset()
        self.master.skip()
        self.master.write(0xBE)
        sp = self.master.read_bytes(9)
        assert crc8(sp, 8) == sp[8]
        return sp

    def start_conversion(self):
        assert self.master.reset()
        self.master.skip()
        self.master.write(0x44)

    def poll_until_done(self) -> float:
        """Poll read slots until the part answers 1, as DallasTemperature does; returns the ms spent."""
        start = self.bus.t
        for _ in range(20_000):
            if self.master.read_bit() == 1:
                return (self.bus.t - start) / 1_000_000
        raise AssertionError('ds18b20 still busy after 20000 polls')

    def convert(self) -> float:
        self.start_conversion()
        return self.poll_until_done()

    def write_scratchpad(self, th, tl, config):
        assert self.master.reset()
        self.master.skip()
        self.master.write(0x4E)
        self.master.write(th)
        self.master.write(tl)
        self.master.write(config)


def temp_c(sp) -> float:
    raw = (sp[1] << 8) | sp[0]
    if raw & 0x8000:
        raw -= 0x10000
    return raw / 16


# ── reset, ROM commands ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_reset_answers_with_presence_every_time():
    r = Rig()
    assert r.master.reset()
    assert r.master.reset()


def test_short_low_is_a_slot_not_a_reset():
    r = Rig()
    r.bus.pull()
    r.bus.advance(100)
    r.bus.release()
    r.bus.advance(70)
    assert r.bus.sample() is True


def _write_with_one_low(bus: Bus, v: int, one_low_us: float):
    """A write slot's bit is the line level at the part's typical 30 us sample point."""
    for i in range(8):
        bus.pull()
        if (v >> i) & 1:
            bus.advance(one_low_us)
            bus.release()
            bus.advance(65 - one_low_us)
        else:
            bus.advance(65)
            bus.release()
            bus.advance(5)


def test_write1_released_before_30us_reads_as_1():
    r = Rig()
    assert r.master.reset()
    _write_with_one_low(r.bus, 0xCC, 20)
    r.master.write(0xBE)
    sp = r.master.read_bytes(9)
    assert crc8(sp, 8) == sp[8]


def test_write1_held_past_30us_reads_as_0():
    r = Rig()
    assert r.master.reset()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r'unsupported ROM command 0x0$'):
        _write_with_one_low(r.bus, 0xCC, 40)


def test_read_rom_returns_family_0x28_with_valid_crc():
    r = Rig()
    assert r.master.reset()
    r.master.write(0x33)
    rom = r.master.read_bytes(8)
    assert rom[0] == 0x28
    assert crc8(rom, 7) == rom[7]
    assert rom == r.dev.rom


def test_read_rom_selects_the_part_for_a_function_command():
    r = Rig()
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.write(0x33)
    r.master.read_bytes(8)
    r.master.write(0xBE)
    sp = r.master.read_bytes(9)
    assert crc8(sp, 8) == sp[8]
    assert sp[4] == 0x7F


def test_search_rom_walks_to_the_one_device_then_reports_no_more():
    r = Rig()
    assert r.master.search() == r.dev.rom
    assert r.master.search() is None
    r.master.reset_search()
    assert r.master.search() == r.dev.rom


def test_search_steered_away_deselects_the_part():
    r = Rig()
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.write(0xF0)
    bit0 = r.dev.rom[0] & 1
    assert r.master.read_bit() == bit0
    assert r.master.read_bit() == bit0 ^ 1
    r.master.write_bit(bit0 ^ 1)
    assert r.master.read_bit() == 1
    assert r.master.read_bit() == 1


def test_match_rom_selects_and_a_one_bit_miss_leaves_the_bus_undriven():
    r = Rig()
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.select(r.dev.rom)
    r.master.write(0xBE)
    sp = r.master.read_bytes(9)
    assert crc8(sp, 8) == sp[8]

    wrong = list(r.dev.rom)
    wrong[3] ^= 0x10
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.select(wrong)
    r.master.write(0xBE)
    assert r.master.read_bytes(9) == [0xFF] * 9


def test_deselected_part_ignores_even_an_unknown_command():
    r = Rig()
    wrong = list(r.dev.rom)
    wrong[0] ^= 1
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.select(wrong)
    r.master.write(0xA5)


def test_skip_rom_selects_the_part():
    r = Rig()
    assert len(r.read_scratchpad()) == 9


def test_unsupported_rom_command_raises():
    r = Rig()
    r.master.reset()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unsupported ROM command 0xa5"):
        r.master.write(0xA5)


def test_unsupported_function_command_raises():
    r = Rig()
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.skip()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unsupported function command 0x0"):
        r.master.write(0x00)


# ── scratchpad and conversion ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_power_on_scratchpad():
    sp = Rig().read_scratchpad()
    assert sp[:8] == [0x50, 0x05, 0x4B, 0x46, 0x7F, 0xFF, 0x0C, 0x10]
    assert temp_c(sp) == 85


def test_convert_latches_on_sixteenth_degree_steps():
    r = Rig(25.0625)
    r.convert()
    sp = r.read_scratchpad()
    assert sp[:2] == [0x91, 0x01]
    assert temp_c(sp) == 25.0625


@pytest.mark.parametrize('config,ms', [(0x1F, 75), (0x3F, 150), (0x5F, 300), (0x7F, 600)])
def test_busy_poll_answers_0_for_the_conversion_then_1(config, ms):
    r = Rig()
    r.write_scratchpad(0x4B, 0x46, config)
    elapsed = r.convert()
    assert ms <= elapsed < ms + 0.15
    for _ in range(5):
        assert r.master.read_bit() == 1


def test_mid_conversion_scratchpad_holds_the_previous_reading():
    r = Rig(20)
    r.start_conversion()
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 85
    r.bus.advance(600_000)
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 20
    r.temp = 40
    r.start_conversion()
    r.bus.advance(590_000)
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 20
    r.bus.advance(10_000)
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 40


def test_temperature_is_sampled_when_convert_is_issued():
    r = Rig(20)
    r.start_conversion()
    r.temp = 40
    r.poll_until_done()
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 20


def test_convert_issued_mid_conversion_is_ignored():
    r = Rig(20)
    r.start_conversion()
    start = r.bus.t
    r.bus.advance(300_000)
    r.temp = 40
    r.start_conversion()
    r.poll_until_done()
    assert 600 <= (r.bus.t - start) / 1_000_000 < 600.15
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 20


def test_temperature_change_needs_a_new_conversion():
    r = Rig(20)
    r.convert()
    r.temp = 40
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 20
    r.convert()
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == 40


def test_negative_and_extreme_temperatures():
    r = Rig(-10.125)
    r.convert()
    sp = r.read_scratchpad()
    assert sp[:2] == [0x5E, 0xFF]
    assert temp_c(sp) == -10.125
    r.temp = -55
    r.convert()
    sp = r.read_scratchpad()
    assert sp[:2] == [0x90, 0xFC]
    assert temp_c(sp) == -55
    r.temp = 125
    r.convert()
    sp = r.read_scratchpad()
    assert sp[:2] == [0xD0, 0x07]
    assert temp_c(sp) == 125


def test_read_power_supply_idles_high():
    r = Rig()
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.skip()
    r.master.write(0xB4)
    assert r.master.read_bit() == 1


def test_write_scratchpad_stores_th_tl_and_config_bits():
    r = Rig()
    r.write_scratchpad(0x1E, 0xEC, 0x1F)
    sp = r.read_scratchpad()
    assert sp[2:5] == [0x1E, 0xEC, 0x1F]
    assert r.dev.resolution_bits == 9
    r.write_scratchpad(0x1E, 0xEC, 0x00)
    assert r.read_scratchpad()[4] == 0x1F
    r.write_scratchpad(0x1E, 0xEC, 0xFF)
    assert r.read_scratchpad()[4] == 0x7F
    assert r.dev.resolution_bits == 12


@pytest.mark.parametrize("config,bits,expected", [
    (0x7F, 12, 25.9375),
    (0x5F, 11, 25.875),
    (0x3F, 10, 25.75),
    (0x1F, 9, 25.5),
])
def test_resolution_truncates_low_bits(config, bits, expected):
    r = Rig(25.9375)
    r.write_scratchpad(0x4B, 0x46, config)
    assert r.dev.resolution_bits == bits
    r.convert()
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == expected


def test_lower_resolution_zeroes_low_bits_of_a_negative_reading():
    r = Rig(-10.0625)
    r.write_scratchpad(0x4B, 0x46, 0x1F)
    r.convert()
    assert temp_c(r.read_scratchpad()) == -10.5


def test_recall_e2_restores_eeprom_and_poll_answers_done():
    r = Rig()
    r.write_scratchpad(0x1E, 0xEC, 0x1F)
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.skip()
    r.master.write(0xB8)
    assert r.master.read_bit() == 1
    assert r.read_scratchpad()[2:5] == [0x4B, 0x46, 0x7F]


def test_copy_scratchpad_polls_0_for_the_2ms_eeprom_write():
    r = Rig()
    assert r.master.reset()
    r.master.skip()
    r.master.write(0x48)
    assert 2 <= r.poll_until_done() < 2.15


def test_copy_scratchpad_commits_to_eeprom():
    r = Rig()
    r.write_scratchpad(0x1E, 0xEC, 0x3F)
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.skip()
    r.master.write(0x48)
    r.write_scratchpad(0x00, 0x00, 0x7F)
    assert r.read_scratchpad()[2:5] == [0x00, 0x00, 0x7F]
    r.master.reset()
    r.master.skip()
    r.master.write(0xB8)
    assert r.read_scratchpad()[2:5] == [0x1E, 0xEC, 0x3F]


# ── alarm flag and Alarm Search ─────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_no_conversion_yet_no_alarm():
    r = Rig()
    assert r.dev.alarm_flag is False
    assert r.master.search(alarm_only=True) is None


def test_default_th_tl_make_room_temperature_an_alarm():
    r = Rig(25)
    r.convert()
    assert r.dev.alarm_flag is True
    assert r.master.search(alarm_only=True) == r.dev.rom


@pytest.mark.parametrize("temperature,alarmed", [
    (25, False),
    (29.9375, False),
    (30, True),
    (40, True),
    (-19, False),
    (-19.5, True),
    (-20, True),
    (-30, True),
])
def test_th30_tl_minus20_compares_the_integer_part(temperature, alarmed):
    r = Rig(temperature)
    r.write_scratchpad(30, 0xEC, 0x7F)
    r.convert()
    assert r.dev.alarm_flag is alarmed
    assert r.master.search(alarm_only=True) == (r.dev.rom if alarmed else None)
